security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: Switch Composer dependencies between vendor and a local checkout
bundle.longDescription: SymfoLinker scans the Composer projects under one development root and switches a dependency between the version Composer installed and a local checkout, without editing composer.json and without deleting the original package.
